description: Provenance of the FOSIT geography tables. All sources are works of the U.S. Government (U.S. Census Bureau / OMB) and are in the public domain in the United States (17 U.S.C. 105).
scope: 50 states + DC. Puerto Rico and the Island Areas are excluded.

sources.vintage: 2020 Census tabulation geography (2020 ZCTA5 to 2020 county relationship file)
sources.description: Pipe-delimited ZCTA-to-county relationship file with land and water area of every ZCTA-county part. National.

sources.vintage: 2022 ACS geography (2022 Connecticut county subdivisions to 2020 ZCTA5)
sources.description: Pipe-delimited Connecticut county-subdivision-to-ZCTA relationship file. 2022 county subdivision GEOIDs embed the planning-region county code (09110-09190), so it re-assigns CT ZCTA parts from the 8 legacy counties to the 9 planning regions.

sources.publisher: U.S. Office of Management and Budget; file published by the U.S. Census Bureau
sources.description: CBSAs, Metropolitan Divisions and CSAs with their component counties.

sources.vintage: Vintage 2025 county population estimates (column POPESTIMATE2025, July 1 2025)
